statement: Chasing site data takes most of my reporting time
quote: It took me almost three months, and most of that was chasing data.
severity_quote: Last spring. It took me almost three months, and most of that was chasing data.

statement: Every site sends data in a different spreadsheet format, so I rebuild it by hand
quote: Energy data comes from each plant manager in a different spreadsheet format, so I rebuild everything by hand.
severity_quote: Energy data comes from each plant manager in a different spreadsheet format, so I rebuild everything by hand.

statement: Late data forces me to sign off numbers I can't trace back
quote: Honestly, I was not comfortable signing off numbers I couldn't trace back.
severity_quote: The Polish plant sent their electricity figures two days before the deadline, and I had to estimate the gap for one quarter.

statement: All our ESG knowledge sits in one person's 40-tab workbook
quote: One master workbook with about forty tabs. If I'm off sick, nobody else can open it and understand it.

statement: Software I've seen is built for large corporates, not us
quote: it was built for large corporates. Too expensive and too many modules we'd never use.

mapping.reason: Market signal about existing tools, not a customer need.

statement: Site managers should enter data once, in one format
quote: I want the plant managers to put their data in once, in the same format, without me chasing them by email.
severity_quote: Because the chasing is where I lose weeks. The analysis part I actually enjoy.
interpretation_note: Underlying need stated at L19: chasing is where time is lost.

statement: Auditors will expect every number to be traceable under CSRD
quote: And with CSRD coming, the auditors will ask where every number came from.
